Name: Multiple Mini-Obelisks Mapped
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]Multiple Mini-Obelisks Mapped[/b][/size]

Place as many mini-obelisks on your farm as you like, and teleport to any of them by picking it on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53998]Live Farm Map[/url]'s farm map.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]No limit of two:[/b] the game stops you placing a third mini-obelisk on the farm. With this mod you can place as many as you want.[/*]
[*][b]On the farm map:[/b] every mini-obelisk on the farm gets a marker on Live Farm Map's farm map. Point at one to see it bigger, with its name.[/*]
[*][b]Click to teleport:[/b] click a marker (or select it with a controller) to teleport next to that mini-obelisk, with the same effect as the game. Like in the game, you need to be on the farm. Off the farm, the markers are greyed out.[/*]
[*][b]Use one to choose:[/b] with two mini-obelisks, using one still takes you to the other like in the game. With three or more, using one opens the farm map so you can pick where to go.[/*]
[/list]If every tile next to the mini-obelisk you picked is blocked, you get the game's "needs space" message and stay where you are.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53998]Live Farm Map[/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installing[/b][/size]
Unzip it into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder, along with Live Farm Map.

[size=4][b]Source code, bugs and suggestions[/b][/size]
The source code is on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods]https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods[/url]
Please report bugs and suggestions as [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods/issues]GitHub issues[/url] rather than on the Bugs or Posts tabs here.
